submission.justification: S1 has the highest nominal significance (4.1 sigma) but fails the hard validation constraint, with 35% data/MC disagreement against a 10% limit. S2 passes at 6% and has the higher significance of the two passing options (3.4 sigma vs 2.6 for S3). I chose the 50% efficiency working point, which is the one the earlier study used. I did not scan other working points.

requirements.evidence: S2 gives 6%, from both the validation study and the tool query.

S2 has 3.4 sigma at 50% efficiency, statistical uncertainty only, from the 2025 summary. It is the best option among those that pass the validation constraint. The working point was not optimised, and the 3.4 sigma figure excludes systematic uncertainties.
